name: Eurite
oneLiner: EURI is Banking Circle's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, issued by a Luxembourg credit institution with fee-free 1:1 redemption against segregated euro reserves.
collateral: Euro cash and low-risk liquid assets held in segregated fiduciary accounts, bankruptcy-remote from Banking Circle S.A.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption at par (fee-free) by Banking Circle S.A.

proofOfReserves.provider: Banking Circle S.A. disclosures (no EY reserve attestation exists: the only EY artefact is the bank's FY2024 entity financial-statements audit, which mentions EURI once and covers no reserve backing; the homepage's 'trusted attestation by a top tier auditor' links no document, and the MiCA whitepaper names only a Fireblocks SOC 2 and a PeckShield contract audit)
